svg.title: A3 two fixed Workspace windows at 65% and 100% camera zoom with the same connected cluster, Draft

g.text: A3 / SEMANTIC ZOOM · TWO VIEWS OF THE SAME WORKSPACE
Same camera centre, node positions, content versions and connections. Only the zoom changes.
More surroundings fit. M4 shows an excerpt. All three reference nodes are visible.
Why do abandoned places feel full
then look at the objects we leave
without explanation. A cup on a sill
suggests a habit; an empty doorway
suggests a departure. We supply the
missing people and the events between
Could the absence feel hopeful instead of
A bench worn smooth by years of
All node sizes and gaps grow by 1.54×. M4 reveals more at the same 13 px text size.
Window chrome stays fixed. The closer camera crops peripheral nodes; nothing was moved, resized individually, rewired or regenerated.
Attachment selections stay unchecked. F1 stays wired to P1 independently. Exact semantic-zoom thresholds remain Draft.
